name: Beata Szydło - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the security of energy supply in the EU
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its position on keeping energy supplies secure. It asks for a full stop to Russian oil, gas and nuclear imports by 2027, with no new gas contracts after 2025. It wants stronger protection of pipelines, cables and power grids against attacks and extreme weather. It also calls for more home-grown renewable energy, better cross-border power links and help for households struggling to heat their homes.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is stating its position and asking the Commission to act.
- **Who it affects:** Energy companies, grid operators, governments and households across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and member states decide whether to turn these requests into law.
